retrieve_dataset_templates: retrieve the prompt templates for a specific dataset like cifar10 or imagenet1k from the TEMPLATES dictionary
build_clip_prompts: build text prompts for CLIP zero-shot classification by substituting class names into dataset-specific templates
summarize_template_coverage: summarize which datasets have prompt templates defined in the TEMPLATES dictionary
compare_template_sets: compare the number of templates between cifar10 and imagenet1k datasets in the TEMPLATES dictionary
extend_template_dataset: extend the TEMPLATES dictionary with new prompt templates for a custom dataset
